question: Does the primary T2* imaging/pharmacological ascorbate soft-tissue-sarcoma report supply authenticated EMC iron/redox measurements, informative comparison and conditions?
source_gap: PMC10777695 full primary histology and donor/condition fields were unacquired in original pilot. Initial EuropePMC500, BioCnonXML and recaptcha HTML are preserved in earlier receipts; none will be repeated.
endpoint_basis: Ordinary public PMC Open Access file service identifies public source packages and license. If a file is provided, use only that documented public file link via HTTPS.
supported_routes: One PMC OA file-service metadata call, then advertised public primary source file only if available; no UI, challenge entry, private access or previously failed route.
read_scope: Primary assay, complete histology roster, eligible EMC donor/condition/treatment and comparator fields. A complete relevant roster can exclude this source only by authenticated source labels; generic sarcoma unresolved.
defeat: No qualifying EMC row, unvalidated imaging-to-iron interpretation, missing conditions/comparison, already published comparison with no new contribution, or access unresolved. None imply biological absence or exhausted search.
storage: Retain raw ignored; no copies of shared input; package limit16MiB within original64MiB task cap; free10GiB floor. Larger relevant data prompt separate stage, never scientific exclusion.
authorization: Lead bounded public OA follow-up while all12 TempO dependency runs; append decision and preserve original scientific freeze.
